summary: Update Record (BYOB): writes changed property values onto an existing record in a self-hosted backend by id.
description: When `update` fires, the record targeted by the node's id input is patched with the values on its schema-generated property inputs. `success` returns the updated `record`; `failure` a structured `error`; `loading` spans the request. As with all BYOB nodes, dependent Query Data results must be re-fetched explicitly.
whenToUse: Editing records on a self-hosted backend. On the managed cloud backend use Set Record Properties (SetDbModelProperties).

ports.record: The record as returned by the backend after the update.

runtimeBehavior: Class choice, the id input and per-property inputs are schema-generated (runtime-discovered).
